name: Codex Immortal MCP
description: Governed enterprise agentic AI platform surface for CodexImmortal: product catalog, cryptographic attestation verification, threat-hunt scan requests, and governed purchase proposals. All calls are metered, firewalled, and audit-logged.

skills.name: Product Catalog
skills.description: List CodexImmortal products and services with pricing basis, capabilities, denied capabilities, and validation status.

skills.name: Attestation Verification
skills.description: Verify cryptographic attestation records by ID or content hash, including signature and ledger inclusion proof.

skills.name: Threat Hunt Scan
skills.description: Request defensive threat-hunt scans: supply-chain, insider-threat, and HNDL triage. Read-only by design.

skills.name: Governed Purchase
skills.description: Prepare purchase proposals for catalog items. Test mode only; live financial execution requires human-gated TGA authorization.
